Welcome back to the GitHub for Beginners series! In this episode, we cover the essentials of getting started with Markdown. Learn how to format text to write clear READMEs, issues, and pull requests that make your projects easy to explore. We walk you through what markdown is, why it matters, and the basic syntax you need to write with confidence. 

#Markdown #GitHubForBeginners #GitHub

05:15 Conclusion
